description: This file defines internal control (ctl) structures, functions, and macros for jemalloc, including control nodes, arena stats, and control interface functions.

classes.name: ctl_node_t
classes.description: Represents a generic control node with a 'named' flag.

classes.name: ctl_named_node_t
classes.description: Represents a named control node with children and a control function.

classes.name: ctl_indexed_node_t
classes.description: Represents an indexed control node with an 'index' function.

classes.name: ctl_arena_stats_t
classes.description: Holds statistics for a jemalloc arena, including small size class stats and bin stats.

classes.name: ctl_stats_t
classes.description: Holds overall statistics for jemalloc, including memory usage and background thread stats.

classes.name: ctl_arena_t
classes.description: Represents a jemalloc arena with stats and configuration.

classes.name: ctl_arenas_t
classes.description: Holds a collection of arenas and related metadata.

methods.name: ctl_nametomib
methods.description: Converts a control name to a MIB (Management Information Base) representation.

methods.name: ctl_bymib
methods.description: Retrieves control information using a MIB.

methods.name: ctl_postfork_parent
methods.description: Reinitializes control subsystem after fork in parent.

methods.name: ctl_postfork_child
methods.description: Reinitializes control subsystem after fork in child.
